<thought>The dominant ESI peak is at m/z 235.1395, which corresponds to [M+H]⁺. Subtracting the proton mass gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈234.1322 Da. An isotopic M+1 intensity of ~16 % matches the expected contribution from ~14 carbons (≈15 % from ¹³C). A formula that fits this mass is C₁₄H₁₈O₃ (exact monoisotopic mass 234.1256 Da, within typical experimental error). No other heteroatoms are required.</thought>
<final_answer>C14H18O3</final_answer>
